title: Voyager map file
description: A racecourse: spawn, rings in race order, the racing line and the boost tuning. Describes the format the catalogue adapters in voyager-platform read. The loader does not validate against this document at runtime; the adapters are the runtime check. Derived fields: a ring's index defaults to its position in rings, and world defaults to name.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors can find it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the file format this file is written in. Absent means 1. This schema describes version 1 only.

name.description: The map's name. Must not be blank.

world.description: The world directory under the worlds path. Optional; when absent it is the name, exactly as written.

referenceTimeSeconds.description: The lap time, in seconds, a new record must beat.

rings.description: The rings in race order. Ring i is the ring at position i.

notes.description: Free text for the person editing the file. Ignored by the loader.

index.description: Optional. When present it must equal the ring's position in rings; a mismatch refuses the file. Left out, the position is used.

normal.description: The unit normal of the disc. Its sign decides which way through the ring counts.

points.description: The score for passing this ring.

cooldownTicks.description: Must be longer than burnDurationTicks; the loader refuses it otherwise.

lookAheadRings.description: How many rings ahead the racing line is shown.

particleSpacing.description: Blocks between drawn particles on the racing line.

orderIndex.description: Where the point sits on the line. Must not be a ring's own slot; the loader refuses that.
